title: Why does your DEWA bill jump in summer?
note: Homes of UAE nationals have their own lower rates; the reel shows the standard home tariff. The AC, bill and display are generic drawings.

facts.said: DEWA charges electricity in four slabs, marked G, Y, O and R (green, yellow, orange, red) on its tariff table.
Standard home tariff: 0 to 2,000 kWh a month 23 fils, 2,001 to 4,000 28 fils, 4,001 to 6,000 32 fils, above 6,000 38 fils.

sources.name: Dubai Executive Council Resolution No. 16 of 2011

facts.said: In summer, air conditioning takes about 60% of the power at peak times (DEWA).

sources.name: DEWA, Energy saving campaign for summer (1 Jul 2009)
DEWA, DEWA recommends rational consumption during summer (22 Jul 2013)
Gulf News, Dewa launches annual peak load reduction campaign

facts.said: A fuel surcharge that changes with fuel prices, and 5% VAT, come on top.

sources.name: Chambers, Power Generation, Transmission and Distribution 2026 (UAE)

facts.said: DEWA's tip: set the air conditioning to 24 degrees.
